HMAC-based one-time password.fact: After verification, the authenticator can authenticate itself simply by generating the next HOTP value, returning it, and then the authenticated can generate their own HOTP value to verify it. The HOTP value is the human-readable design output, a d-digit decimal number (without omission of leading 0s): HOTP value = HOTP(K, C) mod 10d.

HMAC-based one-time password.subject: Computer & IT

HMAC-based one-time password.fact: HOTP is a truncation of the HMAC of the counter C (under the key K and hash function H): HOTP(K, C) = truncate(HMACH(K, C)), where the counter C must be used big-endian.
